control-agent-server api POST "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID/switch_acp_model" --json '{}' --expect 422 --check detail.0.loc.1 eq model
control-agent-server api POST <redacted:session-cookie>/00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000000/switch_acp_model --json '{"model": "opus"}' --expect 404
control-agent-server api GET "<redacted:session-cookie>/$CID" --quiet --check agent.kind eq Agent --check agent.llm.model eq openai/qa-f09-ws --check current_model_id missing
